capabilities: Define folder-level templates as !Template.md notes whose frontmatter sets expected properties
Inherit properties recursively from parent folder templates with unlimited nesting
Auto-apply template properties (and optionally body) to newly created empty notes
Show a status icon for template conformance and navigate to the reference template
Reconform notes to the template through a three-step Update/Align/Reset button
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later (uses the declarative settings API). The optional Templater bridge is opt-in per device and warns that script blocks execute code; the plugin never edits existing notes automatically.
intentEvidence: You would usually use Templater for such occurrences, but what happens when maybe an item needs a new property
motivation: The author hit this problem tracking media in a personal vault and built the solution for others: "I struggled a bit with this kind of problem in my media tracking vault and came up with a solution".
problem: Templater-style per-folder templates force either empty extra properties or divergent copies, with no guarantee that sibling folders' templates share common properties.

relations.evidence: This is meant to work alongside Templater script automations

summary: Folder-level cascading template system where !Template.md files define frontmatter properties inherited recursively by notes and nested templates.
